Hi, my first interaction with Gulmohor Travels was an overnight excursion to Raigad Fort 4 or 5 years ago, and like any first timer I was a bit wary about how it would turn out. But the way the tour was conducted by Messrs Subodh Joshi, Sachin Joshi and other team members left a good and lasting impression on me. Ever since then,  I have participated in at least 6 or 7 tours with them so far and every time it has been a very pleasurable and satisfying experience that makes me want to participate in yet another tour!

To summarize  my experience with Gulmohor Travels I shall mention  the following  which I have liked about them :

1. Personal Touch : The owners Mr. Subodh Joshi and his son Mr. Sachin Joshi personally accompany the tour and oversee all the arrangements with able support of their other team members . So tourists are made comfortable in every possible way with no cause for complaint.

2. Destinations :  Besides the traditional tourist destinations within the Maha State, some of the other places chosen are very unique which one would never have even heard of. This makes the tours very interesting and rewarding.

The outstation destinations such as hill stations , national parks, etc in different states offer a good choice for the tourists.

3. Food : The food served is very traditional and excellent, home cooked at places wherever possible, and also provide a choice of veg / non-veg at specific destinations.

4. Value for Money : The places selected for tours, the food served, the care taken of the tourists, makes it a very relaxing journey every time and certainly gives Value for Money spent.

Wishing the very best to Gulmohor Travels!
